meta.criticalFinding: The domain's GSC history is dominated by its former brand ('Advanced Regen Medical' — see Footer.tsx social links), an orthopedic/regenerative-medicine practice. Top historical queries (regenerative medicine, stem cell therapy, PRP, sanexas, PEMF, peptides, ozone/prolozone therapy, IV therapy, semaglutide) and top pages (/sanexas, /pemf, /pulse-wave, /regen, /knees, /hips, /shoulders, /orthopedics) reflect that old positioning, not the current NeuroIntegrative Care brain/functional-neurology brand. Per user direction (2026-09-29), this plan only builds on services confirmed in current site content: PRP/exosomes (Regenerative Solutions tool), PEMF, longevity/biological-age testing, and detoxification. Sanexas, ozone/prolozone, peptide injections, IV vitamin therapy, and semaglutide are NOT included — no current content confirms the clinic still offers them.
meta.cityKeywordMethodology: DataForSEO/Google Ads keyword data returns null (no trackable volume) for essentially all condition/service + small-city combinations (e.g. 'brain fog treatment Saratoga') — confirmed by testing all 288 seed×city combinations below in cityVariantVolumeTest, 0 returned non-null. This is expected/normal for hyperlocal long-tail medical queries and does NOT mean zero real demand; Google Ads underreports non-commercial, ultra-specific local queries. Per instructions, real demand is validated at the PARENT keyword level (this file); city pages are justified by genuine local service-area relevance (real drive times/routes, existing /locations precedent) rather than by per-city tool volume.
